summary: When a chat's codex app-server exits (killed or crashed) and nobody stopped the session, the next send starts a new app-server, resumes the same Codex thread with thread/resume, and then sends the turn. One start attempt per send: if the new app-server fails to start, that send gets the error and the next send tries again. A stopped session is never restarted. Sends that arrive during a restart wait for its initialize and thread/resume. The skill list and model catalog carry over.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone sends turns through the desktop or headless backend, which runs the Codex adapter. No phone code or wire change.

nativeAndroid.reason: The phone sends turns through the desktop or headless backend, which runs the Codex adapter. No phone code or wire change.

storageDataMigration.reason: The restart keeps the Codex thread id in memory and resumes it. Nothing is stored or migrated.

updateRelease.reason: Main-process change only. It ships with the next desktop and headless server release on their usual lanes.
